# Curated AI

> The greatest AI-assisted projects, curated by humans.

A catalogue of projects that show how to use AI well: useful, innovative, human-reviewed and free of AI slop. Films, music, games, websites, software, design, writing and more.

## Pages
- [Websites & web apps](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/websites.html): Sites, landing pages, online tools and browser experiences where AI did real work and a human shaped the result.
- [Software & tools](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/software.html): Apps, extensions, scripts, automations and open-source projects built with or around AI.
- [Games & interactive](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/games.html): Games, interactive fiction, simulators and digital toys where AI is a mechanic, not a gimmick.
- [Video & animation](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/video.html): Short films, music videos, animation, motion design and documentaries directed by people and rendered with AI.
- [Music & audio](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/music.html): Songs, podcasts, sound design, voice and restoration work where AI served the ear.
- [Illustration & image](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/illustration.html): Illustration, comics, concept art, photography and image series with a visible authorial hand.
- [Graphic design & branding](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/design.html): Identities, posters, typography, packaging and editorial design that used AI as a studio tool.
- [Writing & publishing](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/writing.html): Books, zines, newsletters, journalism, scripts and poetry co-written and edited by humans.
- [Education & explainers](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/education.html): Courses, interactive explainers, tutors and reference works that teach better because of AI.
- [Data & science](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/data.html): Visualizations, datasets, scientific results and maps that only exist because of machine learning.
- [3D, product & space](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/physical.html): 3D modelling, architecture, fashion, furniture and physical objects designed with AI.
- [Art & experimental](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/category/art.html): Generative art, installations, performances and works that take AI itself as their medium.
- [AI History Timeline](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/ai-history-timeline.html): A free bilingual museum of artificial intelligence, from Ada Lovelace in 1843 to today, with every milestone backed by two press articles, plus a glossary and free courses.
- [ArtCraft Crafting Apps](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/artcraft.html): Seven free, open-source desktop apps written in Rust to replace Photoshop, Premiere, Lightroom and the rest of Adobe's suite, coded with AI in a matter of days.
- [Australian Culture](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/australian-culture.html): A guide to understand Australia and Australians: famous Aussies, cities, food, slang dictionary, key dates, brands and curiosities, in English and Portuguese.
- [Brazilian Culture](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/brazilian-culture.html): A journey to understand Brazil and Brazilians, built for foreigners: people, cities, food, music, dates and curiosities, in English and Portuguese.
- [GOATs](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/goats.html): Who is the greatest athlete of all time in each sport? GOATs, legends, stars and prospects across more than 300 disciplines, each with sources and a verification level.
- [Guia de Argumentação](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/guia-de-argumentacao.html): A free course in 151 chapters on how to argue for animals, built from a twelve-volume ethics series and generated as a static site.
- [Types of Rock](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/types-of-rock.html): The theory of evolution applied to rock music: 97 genres on an interactive tree with history, sound, genealogy and the greatest artists of each.
- [Bitchat](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/bitchat.html): A messenger that works with no internet, hopping between phones over Bluetooth, written by Twitter's co-founder in a weekend with an AI coding agent.
- [El Eternauta](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/el-eternauta.html): The first Netflix original with generative AI in its final footage: a building collapse in Buenos Aires that the show's budget could not have covered the traditional way.
- [fly.pieter.com](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/fly-pieter.html): A multiplayer flight simulator in the browser, coded almost entirely by prompting, that went viral and sold in-game ads.
- [Kalshi NBA Finals ad](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/kalshi-nba-finals.html): A deliberately chaotic thirty-second spot generated with Veo 3 for about two thousand dollars of prompting, aired during the 2025 NBA Finals.
- [The Way of Code](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/the-way-of-code.html): The Tao Te Ching rewritten as eighty-one meditations on vibe coding, each paired with an interactive artwork the reader can remix by prompting.
- [Whispers from the Star](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/whispers-from-the-star.html): You keep an astronaut named Stella alive on an alien planet by talking to her, by text, voice or video call. There is no quest line; what you say is the game.
- [Air Head](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/air-head.html): A short film about a man with a balloon for a head, one of the first narrative pieces made with Sora.
- [Cal AI](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/cal-ai.html): Photograph your plate and the app estimates its calories. Built by two eighteen-year-olds, it passed five million downloads in eight months by the founders' count.
- [Infinite Craft](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/infinite-craft.html): A browser game where you drag two words together and a language model decides what they become, forever.
- [Oasis](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/oasis.html): A playable Minecraft-like world with no game engine: every frame is generated by a model from your keyboard and mouse input, in real time.
- [Pedigree Adoptable](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/pedigree-adoptable.html): A model turns amateur shelter photos into studio-quality portraits, so every Pedigree ad becomes an ad for a real dog waiting in a shelter nearby.
- [Rep. Jennifer Wexton's voice](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/wexton-voice.html): A congresswoman who lost her speech to a neurological disease addressed the House of Representatives in a clone of her own voice, built from recordings made before her diagnosis.
- [Sympathy Tower Tokyo](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/sympathy-tower-tokyo.html): The novel that won Japan's Akutagawa Prize, after which its author said about five percent of the text was taken verbatim from ChatGPT.
- [Be My AI](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/be-my-ai.html): Blind and low-vision users photograph anything and receive a detailed description, with a human volunteer one tap away.
- [Chatbot Arena](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/chatbot-arena.html): Two anonymous chatbots answer the same prompt, you pick the better one, and millions of such votes produce the leaderboard the industry watches.
- [Death of an Author](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/death-of-an-author.html): A murder-mystery novella written with three language models, published by Pushkin Industries with the process in the open.
- [Elf.Tech](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/elf-tech.html): Grimes released a tool that turns any recording into her voice and promised fifty percent of royalties to anyone who makes a successful song with it.
- [Glaze & Nightshade](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/glaze-nightshade.html): Two free tools that let artists protect their images: Glaze hides their style from models, Nightshade poisons unauthorised training. Nightshade was downloaded 250,000 times in five days.
- [GraphCast](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/graphcast.html): A weather model that produces ten-day global forecasts in under a minute and beat the leading physics-based system on about ninety percent of the measures tested.
- [Khanmigo](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/khanmigo.html): A tutor that refuses to give the answer: it asks questions, hints and checks the student's reasoning instead.
- [Make Real](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/make-real.html): Draw a rough interface on a whiteboard, press one button, and a working prototype appears next to your sketch, ready to click.
- [Now and Then](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/now-and-then.html): The last Beatles song, finished from a 1970s John Lennon demo after machine learning separated his voice from the piano.
- [Suck Up!](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/suck-up.html): You are a vampire who must talk his way into people's homes; every neighbour is a language-model character who can be convinced or offended.
- [The Frost](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/the-frost.html): A twelve-minute science-fiction film in which every shot started as a DALL·E 2 image, later animated.
- [Contexto](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/contexto.html): The Brazilian answer to Semantle: guess the secret word by meaning, ranked by a language model, which became the big word game of early 2023 far beyond Brazil.
- [Craiyon (DALL·E mini)](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/craiyon.html): The free, open image generator that produced the wonky nine-image grids which flooded social media in mid-2022, months before the big models opened up.
- [Google Flood Hub](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/flood-hub.html): A public site with river flood forecasts up to seven days ahead, built for regions without gauges, covering eighty countries since 2023.
- [Have I Been Trained?](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/have-i-been-trained.html): A search engine that lets artists check whether their work is among the billions of images used to train image generators, and opt out of future training.
- [Heinz A.I. Ketchup](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/heinz-ai-ketchup.html): Heinz asked an image model to draw ketchup in every style it could think of, and almost every result came back shaped like a Heinz bottle.
- [Semantle](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/semantle.html): A daily word game where every guess gets a score for how close its meaning is to the secret word, computed by a word-embedding model.
- [The Crow](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/the-crow.html): A dance performance filmed in a studio and re-painted frame by frame by an image model guided by the prompt of a crow.
- [The Heart Part 5](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/heart-part-5.html): A single-take music video in which Kendrick Lamar's face morphs into O.J. Simpson, Kanye West, Will Smith, Kobe Bryant and Nipsey Hussle as the verses change perspective.
- [The Infinite Conversation](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/infinite-conversation.html): An endless, never-repeating conversation between synthetic versions of Werner Herzog and Slavoj Žižek, with a new segment added every day.
- [Théâtre D'opéra Spatial](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/theatre-dopera-spatial.html): The Midjourney image that won first place in the digital art category of the Colorado State Fair and started the debate about AI in art competitions.
- [Top Gun: Maverick, Val Kilmer's voice](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/top-gun-maverick-voice.html): Val Kilmer, who lost his speaking voice to throat cancer, returned as Iceman with a synthetic version of his own voice built from old recordings.
- [Unsupervised](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/unsupervised.html): A wall-sized moving painting at MoMA, generated from the museum's own collection and reacting to light, sound and movement in the lobby.
- [Zarya of the Dawn](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/zarya-of-the-dawn.html): A short graphic novel whose images were generated with Midjourney and whose text, layout and story were written by its author.
- [AlphaFold Protein Structure Database](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/alphafold-db.html): Predicted 3D structures for over 200 million proteins, free to anyone, covering nearly every organism with a sequenced genome.
- [Deep Nostalgia](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/deep-nostalgia.html): Upload an old family photo and the face blinks, turns and smiles. Tens of millions of ancestors were animated in the first weeks.
- [Lost Tapes of the 27 Club](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/lost-tapes-27-club.html): New songs in the style of Nirvana, Amy Winehouse, Jimi Hendrix and The Doors, generated to talk about mental health in the music industry.
- [Merlin Bird ID: Sound ID](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/merlin-sound-id.html): Hold up your phone and the app names the birds singing around you, live, even when several sing at once.
- [Blob Opera](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/blob-opera.html): Four blobs sing opera as you drag them up and down, harmonising in real time with voices learned from sixteen hours of four real singers.
- [Pharmako-AI](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/pharmako-ai.html): The first book co-written with GPT-3: a dialogue about ecology, memory and consciousness in which both voices are printed.
- [Unfinished Votes](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/unfinished-votes.html): Joaquin Oliver, killed in the Parkland shooting, appears in a video asking young people to vote for gun reform, made with his parents.
- [A.I. chair](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/ai-chair.html): A chair designed by asking generative software to hold a body with the least material, then edited by a designer until it looked like a chair.
- [AI Dungeon](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/ai-dungeon.html): The text adventure that first showed a language model could run an open-ended story with a player.
- [Dalí Lives](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/dali-lives.html): Visitors to the Dalí Museum in Florida are greeted by a life-size Salvador Dalí who talks about his life and takes a selfie with them.
- [Malaria Must Die](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/malaria-must-die.html): A campaign video in which David Beckham's lips are synced to nine languages so that survivors' voices speak through him.
- [PROTO](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/proto.html): An album recorded with Spawn, a neural network Herndon trained on her own voice and on a choir of collaborators.
- [This Person Does Not Exist](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/this-person-does-not-exist.html): A single page that shows a new photorealistic face on every reload, none of which belongs to a real person.
- [Portrait of Edmond de Belamy](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/edmond-de-belamy.html): The first AI-generated artwork sold by a major auction house: a blurred portrait signed with the model's loss function, sold at Christie's for 432,500 dollars.
- [Seek by iNaturalist](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/seek-inaturalist.html): Point the camera at a plant, bug or animal and the app identifies it on the device, with badges for kids and no account required.
- [Te Hiku Media speech tools](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/te-hiku.html): A Māori broadcaster built its own speech recognition for te reo Māori from recordings donated by the community, under a data licence the community controls.
- [Deep Empathy](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/deep-empathy.html): Photos of Boston, London and other cities rendered as if they had suffered the war in Syria, to make distant suffering feel near.
- [Nutella Unica](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/nutella-unica.html): Seven million jars, each with a unique label generated from a set of patterns and palettes designed by the agency.
- [Seeing AI](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/seeing-ai.html): A free app that narrates the world for blind users: reads text and documents, recognises people and products, describes scenes and currency.
- [Quick, Draw!](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/quick-draw.html): A game that asks you to doodle an object in twenty seconds while a neural network guesses what it is, which quietly collected the largest doodle dataset in the world.
- [Sunspring](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/sunspring.html): A nine-minute film whose screenplay was written entirely by a recurrent neural network and performed straight by human actors.
- [The Next Rembrandt](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/project/next-rembrandt.html): A new 'Rembrandt' portrait computed from 346 paintings and printed in 3D to reproduce the brushstroke relief.
- [About](https://curatedai.biblioverse.org/about.html)
